caption:
(2x³)⁴: the 2 gets the power too.

(xᵃ)ᵇ = xᵃᵇ and every factor inside is raised, so (2x³)⁴ = 2⁴x¹² = 16x¹².

Save this before your next practice test.
tiktok_caption: (2x³)⁴ = 16x¹², not 2x¹². Every factor gets the power.

youtube.title: Power of a Power: Why (2x³)⁴ = 16x¹²
youtube.description: Exponent rules aren't on the SAT reference sheet. Worked example: (2x³)⁴ = 16x¹², since the 2 is raised to the 4th too.
